key_quote: Following the conclusion of these purchases, the Committee directs the Desk to purchase Treasury securities with remaining maturities of 6 years to 30 years with a total face value of about $267 billion by the end of December [masked number of year] and to sell or redeem Treasury securities with remaining maturities of approximately 3 years or less with a total face value of about $267 billion.
